# Player at rows 24-27, cols 48-50
# Dark gray shape at rows 28-31, cols 16-23

# Move LEFT multiple times to reach the dark gray shape
for i in range(12):
    result = action(['LEFT'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    for node in seg['nodes']:
        if node['color'] == 'N':
            player_pos = node['boundary']
            break
    # Check if player is near the dark gray shape
    if player_pos[0][1] <= 23:  # player col <= 23
        print(f"LEFT {i+1}: Player at {player_pos}, stopping")
        break
    print(f"LEFT {i+1}: Player at {player_pos}")

# Check state
seg = current_frame.segmentation
print("\nState:")
for node in seg['nodes']:
    if node['color'] in ('N', 'c', 'b', 'W'):
        print(f"  {node['color']}: pixels={node['pixels']}, boundary={node['boundary']}")
